title: Harden base ruleset: promote 21 rules back to Error
summary: 21 analyzer rules were promoted from Warning back to Error in the base ruleset after measuring violations across all country-specific builds, with source code fixes applied where needed to address the handful of violations found.
key_points: 21 rules promoted from Warning to Error: AA0013, AA0189, AA0199, AA0213, AA0230, AA0604, AL0269, AL0424, AL0457, AL0482, AL0551, AL0590, AL0602, AL0775, AL0842, AS0075, AS0079, AS0111, AS0113, AS0126, PTE0017
Small source fixes (Locked = true, begin placement, application area ordering and casing, redundant ShowAsTree) in 12 app and test files across several country layers
AS0094, AL1026 and PTE0014 stay as Warning with justifications tied to legacy XML permission sets that still need converting
Rules with zero violations were promoted outright; rules with a few violations were fixed at source first
Base ruleset overrides reduced from 127 to 106
